title: Promising with great support and fair pricing!
body:
I am trying this app among others of the same category.

Till now, I had great and fast support on some of my questions.
Moreover, HabitHub offer nice tracking features and progress overview.

Last but not least, it has a fair price of 3.99€ for lifetime premium, which is needed in order to track more than 3 habits. Most of the other apps offer way more expensive lifetime purchases or monthly/yearly subscriptions.
author: LykP
